title: Training Notes on Home Oxygen Therapy: Useful Lifetime and Replacement Elections
content:
# Useful Lifetime and Replacement Elections — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Rule.** When the coverage class's oxygen useful lifetime in months has elapsed from the first day of the first paid month of the period, the patient may elect new Home Oxygen Therapy equipment on a replacement election request; the election closes the record as lifetime ended and opens a new oxygen record with a new payment period and a new cap. The useful lifetime is complete only after the coverage class's oxygen useful lifetime months have elapsed since the first paid month of the period began, counting calendar months from the payment-period start date with month-end fallback to the last day of a shorter month and the boundary day included. Without an election the existing equipment stays in the home and is furnished without equipment payment. No election is accepted before the lifetime is complete, whatever the equipment's age or condition.

## The lifetime as a time gate

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Event the clock starts from | the first paid month of the period began |
| Record that shows it | the payment-period start date on the oxygen record (system record) |
| Length | the coverage class's oxygen useful lifetime, in months |
| Counting | calendar months from the payment-period start date, falling back to the last day of a shorter month |
| Comparison | the lifetime is complete on or after the boundary day |
| The boundary day itself | included: the lifetime is complete on that day |
| Before the boundary day | no election is accepted, whatever the equipment's age or condition |

## Questions answered

**When is the boundary day for a hypothetical 60-month lifetime and a payment-period start date of 15 March 2021?** 15 March 2026. An election on 15 March 2026 is accepted; one on 14 March 2026 is not.

**How does the month-end fallback work?** With a hypothetical 60-month lifetime and a payment-period start date of 29 February 2020, the same day sixty calendar months later does not exist in February 2025, so the boundary day falls back to 28 February 2025.

**What happens if the patient does not elect new equipment?** The existing equipment stays in the home and is furnished without equipment payment.

**What does an election do to the records?** It closes the record as lifetime ended and opens a new oxygen record with a new payment period and a new cap.

**Is an election accepted early because the equipment is old or worn?** No. No election is accepted before the lifetime is complete, whatever the equipment's age or condition.
